instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Index No' instead of 'Roll No' everywhere.
Implement 'Red Alert' logic: If predicted Term 3 mark < 35, show red warning icon.
Use Linear Regression for prediction (Term 1 & Term 2 -> Term 3).
Login page MUST have password visibility toggle (Eye icon).
Pre-load 3500 students and 101 teachers with Sri Lankan names (e.g., Perera, Silva, Fernando).
Ensure all dashboards are fully functional (No 'Coming Soon').
Use the provided image URLs for avatars and backgrounds.
Follow the 'Light Blue Professional' theme strictly.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetic; use distinct, professional styling.
Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Do not apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all').
Do not center-align the app container.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than typical).
Use named exports for components and default exports for pages.
